title: The $710K Mistake of Keeping Too Much Cash
hook: You've got fifty thousand in a savings account feeling smart — but over thirty years that 'safety' is quietly costing you seven hundred and ten thousand dollars.
angle: Opportunity cost of excess cash is massive and almost never discussed — most people feel virtuous about large savings balances, but keeping more than 3-6 months of expenses in a low-yield account is a six-figure mistake
audience: Middle-income earners aged 30-50 who feel responsible keeping large cash savings but don't understand the compound opportunity cost
key_numbers: $872,470 — $50K in index fund at 10% after 30 years
66% of Americans hold more cash than they need
